intro.description: 1 Introduction: two million people in a day, a city that learned masks from SARS, and a record that names every maker

before.description: 2 Before consumption: six layers from Jerusalem, Hong Kong and Vietnam, bought without a tender and partly untested

usage.description: 3 Usage and consumption: who got it, whether masks work, and how mask cultures differ

after.description: 4 After consumption: 1.56 billion masks in the sea and ten million copper masks with no plan for their end

end.description: 5 Conclusion and suggestions: the seventh layer
